slides.title: Beyond ANNs

visualInspection.notes: Source overstates parameter count: 28×28=784 grayscale inputs connected to100 hidden units gives78,400 weights plus100 biases=78,500, not over1million. Larger parameter count can increase overfitting risk but does not guarantee it. ANN is a broad category that includes CNN; flattening is a reversible reindexing, not destruction of pixel information, though dense architecture lacks built-in spatial locality/weight sharing. CNN retains spatial feature maps until optional flatten/pooling/head, not necessarily throughout every layer. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Evolution of CNNs

visualInspection.notes: Timeline: LeNet5 1998, AlexNet2012, VGG/RCNN2014, Fast/FasterRCNN and ResNet2015, YOLOv1 2016, EfficientNet2019, YOLO5–8 2020+. Contributions: VGG3×3, AlexNetGPU/large data, R-CNN proposals, ResNet residual skip, EfficientNet compound width/depth/resolution. Source conflates Fast and Faster R-CNN as introducing RPN; RPN belongs specifically to Faster R-CNN. First-backprop-success claim for LeNet5 1998 is historically overbroad. Distinguish publication versus preprint dates; do not silently memorize timeline as all-first claims. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: The core operation: Convolution

visualInspection.notes: Formula uses plus offsets I(i+m,j+n)K(m,n): mathematically cross-correlation, commonly named convolution in CNN APIs; distinguish from Lecture32 minus-offset convention. Small local receptive fields and shared filter across positions; stride step. Zero padding can preserve size only with appropriate kernel/stride/padding, not any padding. Cat diagram shows stages and learned feature combinations as illustration, not proof every specific learned filter has a named semantic role. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Components of a CNN

visualInspection.notes: Formula O=floor((I−K+2P)/S)+1 applies ordinary dilation1, symmetric padding, no ceil mode. Input28×28×1, Conv1 kernel5×5 stride1 padding0 output24×24×16.16 is filter count/output channels; each filter spans all input channels. Figure repeats Conv2 8×8×32 then pool4×4×32. Derivable Conv1 weights25×1×16 and biases16 gives416; parameter sharing avoids one kernel per output location. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Components of a CNN

visualInspection.notes: Conv2 maps12×12×16 to8×8×32 using5×5 stride1 no padding; pooling to4×4×32; flatten512. Flatten changes layout, not number of values, and has no learned weights. Dense scores then softmax for mutually exclusive multiclass or sigmoid for binary; sigmoid can also support independent multilabel outputs, so the source pairing is a common use not exhaustive. Increasing channels as spatial sizes shrink is design choice, not mandatory rule. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Object Detection: Beyond Classification

visualInspection.notes: Detection combines class identification and localization; cat96% and dog98% figure illustrates boxes and labels, not measured dataset accuracy. Bounding box(x,y,w,h) coordinate convention must be specified; x/y may mean center or corner in different formats. Multiple objects, one class label alone lacks locations; boxes are not pixel masks. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Types of Object Detection Models

visualInspection.notes: Table contrasts region-proposal/classification R-CNN/Fast/Faster R-CNN with one-stage YOLO direct box/class predictions on feature maps. Architecture stages are not the number of layers or number of postprocessing operations. These are lecture categories, not exhaustive current detector taxonomy. slides.title: Single-Stage Detection using YOLO

visualInspection.notes: YOLO single forward CNN pass predicts localization, scores and classes without a separate proposal pipeline. Regression framing includes continuous box prediction and class prediction, not a claim detection has no classification component. Real-time is design goal and measured hardware/model/input-dependent, not universal speed guarantee. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: YOLO v1 – How it works

visualInspection.notes: YOLOv1 S×S grid, B=2 boxes/cell, each box has x,y,w,h,confidence. Center offsets relative to owning cell; width/height relative to whole image. IoU intersection/union, not intersection divided by sum without subtraction. Confidence target interpretation P(object)×IoU; class-conditioned score must not be conflated with objectness alone. Primary source needed for responsibility rule and conditional class interpretation. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.

slides.title: Object Detection using YOLO v8

visualInspection.notes: Ultralytics2023YOLOv8; anchor-free (no predefined width/height anchor boxes), decoupled classification/regressionbranches, C2f feature blocks and multi-scale fusion. Anchor-free is not absence of grid/reference points, and officialimplementation decodes distances toboxedges rather than simply directcenter-onlypredictions. Fine/highresolutionfeatures and deepersemanticfeatures complementary, notguaranteed detectionatallscales. Actual full 1800-pixel page and footer viewed.
